name: Adhere
description: An object is covered in extremely sticky slime. Adjacent objects stick to the book with great force.

name: Anchor
description: A strong wire sprouts from your arms, affixing itself to two points within 50ft on each side. If a rope is pulled through the iron loop on its spine, it becomes as heavy as an elephant.

name: Animate Object
description: An object obeys your commands as best it can. Moldable like clay. Childish laughter sprouts from its pages.

name: Anthropomorphize
description: An animal either gains human intelligence or human appearance for one day. Whimpers, purrs and growls depending on its treatment.

name: Arcane Eye
description: You can see through a magical floating eyeball that flies around at your command. Needs a spritz of water to open.

name: Astral Prison
description: An object is frozen in time and space within an invulnerable crystal shell. Silent, abstract, faces scream in anguish within.

name: Attract
description: Two objects are strongly magnetically attracted to each other if they come within 10 feet. Nearby compasses spin uselessly.

name: Auditory Illusion
description: You create illusory sounds that seem to come from a direction of your choice. Produces random and occasionally inopportune sounds throughout the day.

name: Babble
description: A creature must loudly and clearly repeat everything you think. It is otherwise mute. When the text is read aloud, the words of others become unintelligible.

name: Bait Flower
description: A plant sprouts from the ground that emanates the smell of decaying flesh. Attracts flies.

name: Beast Form
description: You and your possessions transform into a mundane animal. Covered in thick fur, its edges lined with small teeth.

name: Befuddle
description: A creature of your choice is unable to form new short-term memories for the duration of the spell. Its contents shift and change each time it is opened.

name: Body Swap
description: You switch bodies with a creature you touch. If one body dies, the other dies as well. The front cover shows an image of the last creature to read it.

name: Charm
description: A creature you can see treats you as a friend. Warm to the touch, and smells of roses.

name: Command
description: A target obeys a single three-word command that does not cause it harm. Grows thinner over time, until finally disappearing forever.

name: Comprehend
description: You become fluent in all languages for a short while. Drips letters, staining whatever it touches.

name: Cone of Foam
description: Dense foam sprays from your hand, coating the target. Spongy and moist with a soapy residue.

name: Control Plants
description: Nearby plants and trees obey you and gain the ability to move at a slow pace. Leaves grow along the spine, and it smells faintly of decay.

name: Control Weather
description: You may alter the type of weather at will, but you do not otherwise control it. Highly resistant to fire and water damage.

name: Cure Wounds
description: Restore 1d4 STR per day to a creature you can touch. Smells of vinegar and thyme. Turns red after use.

name: Deafen
description: All nearby creatures are deafened. Nearby instruments occasionally sound off, as if in protest.

name: Detect Magic
description: You can see or hear nearby magical auras. Becomes warm to the touch if magic is used nearby.

name: Disassemble
description: Any of your body parts may be detached and reattached at will, without causing pain or damage. You can still control them. Regenerates any torn or defaced pages.

name: Disguise
description: You may alter the appearance of one character at will as long as they remain humanoid. Attempts to duplicate other characters will seem uncanny. The surface makes a perfect mirror.

name: Displace
description: An object appears to be up to 15ft from its actual position. Bits of string, clothing, and leaves are sometimes stuffed inside.

name: Earthquake
description: The ground begins shaking violently. Structures may be damaged or collapse. Sand dribbles from the corners, seemingly without stop.

name: Elasticity
description: Your body can stretch up to 10ft. Smells of taffy, and is very flexible.

name: Elemental Wall
description: A straight wall of ice or fire 50ft long and 10ft high rises from the ground. Skin and warmer substances stick to it after use.

name: Filch
description: A visible item teleports to your hands. An ally's prized possession may occasionally be found tucked between its covers.

name: Fish Lung
description: A target can breathe underwater until they surface again. Smells strongly of the sea. Attracts wild animals.

name: Flare
description: A bright ball of energy fires a trail of light into the sky, revealing your location to friend or foe. Faintly glows in complete darkness.

name: Fog Cloud
description: A dense fog spreads out from you. When submersed in water, the book eventually turns all the liquid to vapor.

name: Frenzy
description: A nearby creature erupts in a frenzy of violence. Rough, sandpaper cover that destroys any book it touches.

name: Gate
description: A portal to a random plane opens. A large hole is carved into the center, ending in a void. Items dropped within are never seen again.

name: Gravity Shift
description: You can change the direction of gravity, but only for yourself. Attaches itself to the largest object nearby.

name: Greed
description: A creature develops the overwhelming urge to possess a visible item of your choice. The cover changes depending on the owner, subtly hinting at their deepest desires.

name: Haste
description: Your movement speed is tripled. Pages flip wildly while open. Can cause paper cuts.

name: Hatred
description: A creature develops a deep hatred of another creature or group and wishes to destroy them. Long term exposure to the book can cause suspicion, paranoia and distrust of others.

name: Hear Whispers
description: You can hear faint sounds clearly. The reader's voice is amplified for a short period of time afterwards.

name: Hover
description: An object hovers, frictionless, 2ft above the ground. It can hold up to one humanoid. Floats if dropped.

name: Hypnotize
description: A creature enters a trance and will truthfully answer one yes or no question you ask it. Eye-catching, swirling spirals don its covers.

name: Icy Touch
description: A thick ice layer spreads across a touched surface, up to 10ft in radius. Gloves required. Nonflammable.

name: Identify Owner
description: Letters appear over the object you touch, spelling out the name of the object's owners, if there are any. The book's interior lists the name of its previous owner.

name: Illuminate
description: A floating light moves as you command. When held in light, the pages become a prism of vibrant rainbows.

name: Invisible Tether
description: Two objects within 10ft of each other cannot be moved more than 10ft apart. Its pages are not attached by glue or thread, yet stay together nonetheless.

name: Knock
description: A nearby mundane or magical lock unlocks loudly. Locked. A new owner "produces" the key after their next meal.

name: Leap
description: You jump up to 10ft high, once. When thrown, it just keeps going.

name: Liquid Air
description: The air around you becomes swimmable. Floats of its own volition, bouncing off of whatever it touches.

name: Magic Dampener
description: All nearby magical effects have their effectiveness halved. Relics within 100ft of the spellbook cannot be recharged.

name: Manse
description: A sturdy, furnished cottage appears for hours. You can permit and forbid entry to it at will. If left inside, both the book and the cottage vanish forever.

name: Marble Craze
description: Your pockets are full of marbles and will refill every 30 seconds. When jostled, makes a playful rattling sound.

name: Masquerade
description: A character's appearance and voice becomes identical to those of a character you touch. Extended use causes the owner to develop unconscious yet noticeable tics.

name: Miniaturize
description: A creature you touch is shrunk down to the size of a mouse. The text is ludicrously, comically large.

name: Mirror Image
description: An illusory duplicate of yourself appears and is under your control. Over time, the owner begins to question who is the original, and who is the duplicate.

name: Mirrorwalk
description: A mirror becomes a gateway to another mirror that you looked into today. Will not open unless the owner politely knocks on the cover.

name: Multiarm
description: You temporarily gain an extra arm. After use, the caster is wracked with phantom limb syndrome for a day.

name: Night Sphere
description: A 50ft-wide sphere of darkness displaying the night sky appears before you. Displays a prominent constellation on its cover.

name: Objectify
description: You become any inanimate object between the size of a grand piano and an apple. The owner experiences intense pareidolia for days after use.

name: Ooze Form
description: You become a living jelly. Slowly drips an acid that eventually eats away anything it touches.

name: Pacify
description: A creature near you has an aversion to violence. Smells of jasmine and incense. Attracts children.

name: Passage
description: Creates a temporary path through wood, stone or brick. An object dropped on top of the book inevitably falls through the other side.

name: Phobia
description: A nearby creature becomes terrified of an object of your choice. Over time, haunting, abstract art begins to fill its pages.

name: Pit
description: A pit 10ft wide and 10ft deep opens in the ground. A standard piton can be safely stored in its spine.

name: Primal Surge
description: A creature rapidly evolves into a future version of its species. The owner is haunted by strange visions of their own ancestors.

name: Push/Pull
description: An object of any size is pulled directly towards you or pushed directly away from you with the strength of one man. Any force against the book is comically amplified.

name: Raise Dead
description: A skeleton rises from the ground to serve you. They are incredibly stupid and can only obey simple orders. The owner becomes more and more fascinated with bones after each use.

name: Raise Spirit
description: The spirit of a nearby corpse manifests and will answer 1 question. The answers (but not their questions) are forever inscribed in its pages.

name: Read Mind
description: You can hear the surface thoughts of nearby creatures. Long-term possession can cause the reader to mistake the thoughts of others as their own.

name: Repel
description: Two objects are strongly magnetically repelled from each other within 10 feet. Closed by two powerful straps that spring open at inopportune times.

name: Scry
description: You can see through the eyes of a creature you touched earlier today. The owner's eyes turn milky-white for an hour after use.

name: Sculpt Elements
description: Inanimate material behaves like clay in your hands. Slowly decays on contact with wood or cloth. Bury in dirt or submerge in water to refresh.

name: Sense
description: Choose one kind of object (key, gold, arrow, jug, etc). You can sense the nearest example. The book's previous owner is always aware of the book's current location.

name: Shield
description: A creature you touch is protected from mundane attacks for one minute. Bound in rusty ring-mail and is quite heavy. If held, provides +1 Armor.

name: Shroud
description: A creature you touch is invisible until they move. Invisible to any but the book's current owner.

name: Shuffle
description: Two creatures you can see instantly switch places. If stolen but not yet read, it reappears wherever its owner last left it.

name: Skillful Repair
description: You make minor repairs to a nonliving object. Sewn from the vellum of one hundred books, no two pages are alike.

name: Sleep
description: A creature you can see falls into a light sleep. Soft as a pillow, but yields only fitful sleep.

name: Slick
description: Every surface in a 30ft radius becomes extremely slippery. Gloves are required for handling, lest the book is dropped in a most comical fashion.

name: Smoke Form
description: Your body becomes a living smoke that you can control. Smells of campfire. The pages cannot be burnt, but are very sensitive to moisture.

name: Sniff
description: You can smell even the faintest traces of scents. Expresses a strong odor detectable only by its owner.

name: Snuff
description: The source of any mundane light you can see is instantly snuffed out. If left in one place for long periods, nearby light sources eventually dim, then finally go out.

name: Sort
description: Inanimate items sort themselves according to categories you set. Rights itself when dropped or thrown.

name: Spellsaw
description: A whirling blade flies from your chest, clearing any plant material in its way. It is otherwise harmless. Wrapped in stained leather, it should be oiled at least once a month.

name: Spider Climb
description: You can climb surfaces like a spider. New cobwebs must be pushed aside prior to each use. They are hard to remove.

name: Swarm
description: You become a swarm of crows, rats, or piranhas. You can only be harmed by blast attacks. Easily broken into a dozen distinct parts that slowly move towards one another over time.

name: Target Lure
description: An object you touch becomes the target of any nearby spell. Attracts all manner of magical creatures, spell leaks, and scrying.

name: Telekinesis
description: You may mentally 1 move item under 60lbs. The owner can summon the book through mental command alone (WIL save or become deprived afterwards).

name: Telepathy
description: Two creatures can hear each other's thoughts, no matter how far apart. The holder can hear (but not respond) to the thoughts of whoever last possessed it, and vice versa.

name: Teleport
description: An object or person you can see is transported from one place to another in a 50ft radius. Can be destroyed to create a portal to another dimension.

name: Thicket
description: A thicket of trees and dense brush up to 50ft wide suddenly sprouts up. Wrapped in vines that must be destroyed again with each use.

name: Time Control
description: Time in a 50ft bubble slows down or increases by 10% for 30 seconds. Alternates its appearance as either impossibly old or freshly written.

name: True Sight
description: You see through all nearby illusions. Cannot be concealed by magic, and sticks out like a sore thumb.

name: Upwell
description: A spring of seawater appears. Hardened leather bindings caked in salt and living barnacles.

name: Vision
description: You completely control what a creature sees. An unnerving, lidless eye graces the front cover.

name: Visual Illusion
description: A silent, immobile, room-sized illusion of your choice appears. Filled with rich, colorful pages very much like a children's bedtime story.

name: Ward
description: A silver circle 50ft across appears on the ground. Choose one species that cannot cross it. The covers are decorated with bizarre, otherworldly creatures with thousands of eyes.

name: Web
description: Your wrists shoot thick webbing. The text is alien, yet somehow intelligible, for it is the language of dreams.

name: Widget
description: A primitive version of a drawn tool or item appears before you and disappears after a short time. Smells of iron and rust, sweat and effort. Faint sounds of harsh labor emanate from deep within its pages.

name: Wizard Mark
description: Your finger can shoot a stream of ulfire-colored paint. This paint is only visible to you and can be seen at any distance, even through solid objects. Inside the front cover is a small pocket containing a thin pad of paper, listing the name and date of death of all previous owners.

name: X-Ray Vision
description: You can see through walls, dirt, clothing, etc. Long-term exposure can cause hair loss, blurry vision, and fatigue.
